note: No entry: a wall is read off a directory entry the viewer is shown, never without one.
An entry named by DID: members are addressed by their community-scoped entry, never by DID.
There is no `includeHidden`: hidden badges are the holder's business, and only vtc/badges/mine/list shows them to the holder.
Bare/unnamespaced ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 requires every immediate child of ext to be reverse-DNS namespaced.
A wall without `visibility`: the viewer must know whether the member shows their badges to members, or they are looking at their own wall.
A wall entry carrying `hidden`: a hidden badge is never a wall entry, so the wall has no such flag; MyBadge, the holder's own view, does.
